clips.title: The story
paras: Ogtinc is an independent furbolg hunter perched on a high ridge overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. Having parted ways with his tribe to serve the balance of nature, he acts as a trusted ally and mentor for the Cenarion Circle. Skilled hunters seeking to test their craft against the fiercest beasts of Kalimdor often seek out his guidance.

While most furbolg in Kalimdor remain fiercely bound to their tribes—or have succumbed to corruption following the Third War—Ogtinc chose a distinct path. Departing from his kin, he dedicated his bow and survival lore to aiding the Cenarion Circle. He makes his camp high on a bluff southeast of Timbermaw Hold, vigilantly watching over the ancient, shattered lands of Azshara.

Ogtinc is renowned among seasoned trackers for his intimate understanding of Kalimdor's wilderness. He tests hunters who have honed their skills across the continents, dispatching them to gather rare trophies—such as the antlers of courser beasts, the scale of wave-thrashed sea serpents, and parts from green dragonkin. Through these trials, he teaches that true hunting honors the natural world and preserves balance rather than mindlessly taking life.
